cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded LIC Classic card providing rewards on LIC premium payments, lifestyle benefits, and simple redemption options.

items.child: Up to 15% discount on dining across 300+ cities.
This card offers roadside assistance of Rs 1,399.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.description: Up to 15% discount on dining across 300+ cities.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining privileges. Complete the payment using your IDFC LIC Classic credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.description: This card offers roadside assistance of Rs 1,399.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to IDFC FIRST Bank Customer Care at 1800 10 888 or email banker@idfcfirstbank.com
